W3 (cost lens), after E057.

**Tip (E049, 3df6233).** 237 steps at batch 2000. Resolution is 20/24/28/32 px at 30/10/30/30% of steps. The whitening bias is detached at 20%, the stem frozen at 75%, and group 2 annealed from 75% and frozen at 90%. Seeds 0–2 have read 0.7535, 0.7552 and 0.7536 (E057) across three builds, at 5.198–5.223 s. My estimate of the unselected population mean is about 0.7530–0.7535, which leaves about 0.3 pp over the 0.75 bar before judge and rebuild drift.

**Noise.**
- Per-seed SD is about 0.3 pp, so a 3-seed SE is about 0.17 pp.
- On seeds 0–2 the tip's builds spread 0.17 pp, which matches seed noise alone. My σ_build prior is about 0.05–0.12 pp for a 20-seed mean.
- Time reproduces to about 1% (5.20–5.22 s).

**Time model.** Time ≈ 0.25 s + Σ(steps × per-step cost).
- Per-step cost: 32 px 0.032 s, 28 px 0.026 s, 24 px 0.021 s, 20 px 0.016 s.
- The stem freeze saves about 0.0087 s per step and the group-2 freeze about 0.010 s more.
- Correction: E046, E052 and E056 all came in 2–3% below my point. I now place removals about 2% faster than the MAC model says.
- The whitening detach moving from 20% to 6% saves only dgrad of g1.conv1 at 20/24 px (cheap phases): about 33 steps × 1–2 ms ≈ 0.04–0.06 s.

**Exchange rates (s saved per pp lost).**

| Lever | Rate / status |
|---|---|
| Epoch dial | ~1–2 |
| ReLU | ~1.2 |
| Width | ~0.7 |
| Stride instead of pool | ~0.45 |
| Group-2 freeze at 90% | near free |
| Stem freeze at 75% | optimal; 71% and 60% are worse than the dial |

**Mechanisms.**
1. Accuracy is bought with steps on layers that are still learning (E041, E045, E053, E054, E055).
2. Lookahead is worth about 1 pp and is already tuned (E025 and E030 both hurt).
3. The late 28/32 px phases carry accuracy. The early phases are step-limited, not pixel-limited.
4. Muon renormalizes the filters every step, so filter wd is inert. Only the SGD-group wd matters.
5. BN scale is already frozen in `BatchNorm.__init__`, so I092 and H1.5.10 close with no run.
6. The harness passes only fine labels, so I091 and H1.8 are blocked.
7. Under Muon, ||ΔW||/||W|| just redraws the imposed LR schedule, so I094's curves can't predict freeze cost.

**Strategy.** The value now is in gate accounting. With σ_tot ≈ 0.13–0.15 pp, the 95% gate needs μ̂ ≥ about 0.7522. E052 and E053, which I expect at about 0.7515–0.7525 on fresh seeds, sit at the margin and probably fail the 53–72 confirmation. E046 (~0.752) is borderline too. If everything fails, E049 stays the tip.

**Unsure.**
- The size of σ_build.
- Winner's curse vs seed-set difficulty on seeds 13–32.
- How much drift the PCIe judge adds.

forecasts.reason: Fresh-seed means for E052 and E053 are probably 0.7515–0.7525, right at the 0.9/0.95 gate boundary. P≥0.9 may pass while the 95% confirmation on seeds 53–72 is a coin flip.
The 0.25-epoch delta is about 0.08 pp, below a σ_diff of about 0.12 pp once σ_build is added. The dial estimate will span 0.6–2 s/pp.
The harness supplies only fine labels, so the mapping would need an external table. The run is blocked, and any number reported is the tip's.
The BN weight already has requires_grad=False in the code, so there is no time saving to find. This closes with no run.
It saves only about 0.04–0.06 s of g1.conv1 dgrad in the cheap 20/24 px phases, below the 1% time noise. Any accuracy change is far below 3-seed resolution.
Under Muon, filter-norm-fixed update rates follow the imposed LR and anneal schedules, so the curves can't separate E028 (75%, free) from E037/E055 (60%/71%, costly) on any independent basis.

cruxes: What is σ_build for a 20-seed mean? Below about 0.06 pp, E052 (4.99 s) and possibly E046 pass the frozen gate. Above about 0.12 pp, nothing faster than E049 passes, and the dial should run toward more steps.
On fresh seeds 33–52, is E049's population mean at least 0.7535, or about 0.752? The second would mean E049 itself is marginal against the 95% gate.
Does the PCIe judge's own build add more than 0.05 pp of accuracy drift, or more than 5% of time, compared with the local SXM4 builds?
